podcast.body: Released in 1982, this album by the heavy post-punk band from England was inspired by the apocalypse as described by St. John in the Bible. "Killing Joke was a very heavy post-punk band from England and in 1982 they released an album called Revelations and yes it was inspired by the apocalypse as described by St. John in the Bible."
